firstLines: Maya Lindqvist
Denver, CO | (720) 555-0137 | maya.lindqvist@example.com | linkedin.com/in/mayalindqvist
SUMMARY
Product manager with four years in scheduling and payments software. I work closely with
design and engineering, talk to customers every week, and like features that are small enough
to ship in a month and measure in the next one.
EXPERIENCE
Product Manager Mar 2023 – Present
Tarrowfield Software Denver, CO
• Own scheduling and shift swaps for about 3,000 hourly teams
• Cut unfilled shifts by 18% by adding swap requests and reminders after interviewing 40
store managers about why shifts went empty
• Run quarterly planning with two engineering teams and a designer
• Wrote the team's first product metrics guide, so every launch now ships with a named
success measure and a review date
Associate Product Manager Jun 2020 – Feb 2023
Ferncastle Payments Denver, CO
• Launched saved cards for repeat customers; checkout time fell by a third
• Ran 25 A/B tests on the payment page and kept a public log of every result
• Handled the product side of a card network change on a fixed deadline
Business Analyst Jul 2018 – May 2020
Gorseholt Distribution Aurora, CO
• Built weekly order reports in SQL and Excel for 12 warehouse managers
• Wrote requirements for a new returns process that reduced manual data entry
EDUCATION
Pinyon Draw University Boulder, CO
Bachelor of Science in Information Systems May 2018
SKILLS
Product: Roadmaps, customer interviews, A/B testing
Tools: Jira, Figma, Amplitude, SQL, Looker
